limitations: Unit TransformInfo is decoded, but its matrices are reported as stored; local/global semantics are not yet validated against the SDK.
A missing dependency in this package may be stored in a different game archive.
GPU vertex streams, MeshInfo sections, StreamInfo component layouts and material payloads are not yet decoded.
BoneInfo matrices are stored joint matrices; the inverse-transform match is reported for validation but is not enforced.
Remap arrays are indexed by MeshInfo material slot; MeshInfo decoding is required to map them to Unit material IDs.
